summary: Verified bug fix for 'logged in then suddenly logged out' in LotNeeti. Backend: 6/6 pytest cases passed — /api/auth/login and /api/auth/register return a 'token' field, Authorization: Bearer <token> is accepted by /api/auth/me and all protected endpoints (/dashboard, /investors, /banks, /ipos, /applications), cookie-only path still works. Frontend (Playwright): (1) demo-credentials login lands on authenticated layout and localStorage.token is set (length 209). (2) 3 reloads keep user logged in. (3) CRITICAL — cleared ALL browser cookies (4 -> 0), kept localStorage, reloaded: user stayed on dashboard and GET /api/auth/me returned 200 (session persists on Bearer alone). (4) Navigated across all 7 pages (Investors, Banks, IPOs, Planner, Applications, Funds, Dashboard) — no logout, no 401 bounce. (5) Logout removed localStorage.token and redirected to /login; reloading /applications stayed on /login. 0 pageerrors throughout.
critical_code_review_comments: AuthContext.logout clears localStorage BEFORE calling /auth/logout, so the backend logout call goes out without the Bearer header (interceptor reads from localStorage). Cookie clearing on the server still happens via Set-Cookie, so it works, but order could be: await api.post('/auth/logout') first, then remove token.

On first page load for logged-out users, AuthContext fires GET /api/auth/me which returns 401 and shows up as a red '401 ()' line in devtools. Harmless (caught), but could be suppressed by only calling /auth/me when localStorage.token exists.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bearer-token-in-localStorage auth fix is fully verified end-to-end. Backend accepts cookie OR Authorization header via get_current_user in /app/backend/server.py. Frontend attaches Bearer in /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js request interceptor; AuthContext persists data.token to localStorage on login/register, removes on logout. The CRITICAL cookie-cleared reload scenario was independently confirmed with Playwright: ctx.clear_cookies() left 0 cookies, token stayed in localStorage, reload resulted in /auth/me -> 200 and the user remained authenticated.
rca of the issue: Original bug: auth depended solely on SameSite=None;Secure httpOnly cookie which some browsers (behind Cloudflare preview) silently drop, causing subsequent requests to 401 and the axios interceptor to redirect to /login — appearing as a sudden logout. Fix (already applied by main agent): backend already supported Bearer; main agent now also returns 'token' in login/register responses, and the frontend stores it in localStorage and attaches it on every request. Session now survives cookie loss entirely.
